# Electrotile

> > Electrotile manufactures Building-Integrated Photovoltaic (BIPV) systems including eTILE solar roof tiles, eBlade solar louvers, and solar carport solutions for architectural integration.

Electrotile specializes in solar architecture products that combine energy generation with aesthetic building design. Their ecosystem includes eTILE solar roof panels, eBlade facade systems, ePark/EBlock carports, and eFence solar balustrades, serving architects, contractors, and resellers across European markets.

## Key Topics

- eTILE solar roof tiles
- BIPV (Building-Integrated Photovoltaics)
- eBlade solar louver systems
- Solar architecture
- Photovoltaic integration
- ePark & EBlock solar carports
- eFence solar balustrades
- Electrotile BIPV technology
- Solar roof installation
- Energy production and billing
- Bioclimatic pergolas
- Architectural solar design
- Net metering systems
- Solar panel aesthetics

## BIPV Product Ecosystem

- [eBlade Sonnenkollektoren - architektura solarna](https://www.electrotile.com/de/ecosystem/eblade-sonnenkollektoren): eBlade solar louver systems (S/M/L) for facades, fences, and balustrades
- [Aluminiumcarportar - architektura solarna](https://www.electrotile.com/se/ecosystem/aluminiumcarportar): ePark & EBlock solar carport systems with LED lighting and eFence integration
- [Solbalustrader - architektura solarna](https://www.electrotile.com/se/ecosystem/solbalustrader): eFence, eBlade & eGlass Rail BIPV balustrade systems with SmartSwitch
